blocks.tamil_translation: hope they call upon their Lord; and they spend (in good ways) from what We have given them. So no soul knows the coolness of the eyes that has been hidden for them as a reward for what they used to do.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنّتٍ وَّعُيُونٍ ۞ آخِذِينَ مَاآتهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ؕ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَبْلَ ذلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ ۞ كَانُوا قَلِيلاً مِّنَ الَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ ۞ وَبِالْأَسْحَارِهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Surely those who fear (their Lord) will be in gardens of Jannah and springs, (they will be) accepting (with joy) what their Lord has given them. Surely before this (in the world) they were doers of good. They used to sleep little of the night, and in the hours before dawn they (used to be) seeking forgiveness.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ ۞ قُمِ الَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلاً ۞ نِّصْفَهُ أَوِانْقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلاً ۞ أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلاً ۞ إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلاً ثَقِيلاً ۞ إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ الَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَّطْاً وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلاً ۞ إِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبْحاً طَوِيلاً۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: O you wrapped in a cloak! Stand (in Salah) at night - except a little - half of it, or reduce a little from that (half)!, or increase (a little time) beyond it!
